rationale: The sole behavioral delta is that the fixed implementation initializes msg->msg_namelen to 0 before all receive processing. The Logic section does not claim that the message name length is initialized, cleared, validated, or otherwise managed. Its statements about socket state, flags, queue retrieval, data copying, socket-type handling, truncation, backlog management, synchronization, and error handling are either supported by both versions or are sufficiently general not to distinguish them.
